run_conversation_cleanup: run the conversation_cleanup script to clean TOD conversation JSONL files for ACUTE format
run_cleanup_with_suffixes: run cleanup_conversation.py with agent suffixes to add unique ID suffixes to speaker turns
run_cleanup_filter_speakers: run cleanup_conversation.py with included-speakers to filter out unwanted speaker turns from conversations
run_cleanup_limit_conversations: run cleanup_conversation.py with num-conversations to limit output to a specific number of conversations
run_cleanup_with_report: run cleanup_conversation.py with a report path to embed task success metrics in cleaned conversations
